entities.name: Sunset Moonland
entities.subtitle: A place where exhausted travelers can begin to belong again.
entities.summary: A lakeside community shaped across centuries by exile, rediscovery and people arriving after the Cessation with nowhere else that could hold them.
body: Sunset Moonland matters because it does not solve the world outside it. It simply proves that another way of living can still exist inside the same broken world.
For Lucas and Teo, the settlement becomes less a destination than an answer to two different kinds of exhaustion: one caused by feeling too much, the other by seeing too far ahead.

timeline.title: The exiled Luminary child
timeline.summary: An unworthy child withdraws to the land, changes slowly, and is eventually welcomed back.

timeline.title: The fisherman returns
timeline.summary: A storm reveals the place. He later comes back with his wife to stay.

timeline.title: A community grows
timeline.summary: Travelers arrive. The settlement grows without becoming an institution first.

timeline.title: Lucas and Teo arrive
timeline.summary: Their journey home changes when they discover a place that already feels like an answer.

meaning.realization: A place becomes home through the quality of relationships rather than origin.

entities.name: Lucas Menezes
entities.subtitle: He feels the need before he feels his own exhaustion.
entities.summary: A 22-year-old environmental engineering student from Salvador whose instinct to help is both his magnetism and his burden.
body: Lucas is defeated by scale rather than cruelty. The more he helps, the more clearly he sees the need that remains.
His arc is not learning to care less. It is discovering that feeling another person's pain does not create an obligation to personally solve everything.

meaning.realization: Feeling deeply does not require carrying everything.

entities.name: Mateus “Teo” Duarte
entities.subtitle: He reads people quickly enough to find a path through them.
entities.summary: A 21-year-old marine biology student from Florianópolis with an unusual ability to understand people and convert that perception into movement.
body: Teo can find an angle through almost any individual interaction, but a bureaucracy has no emotional state for him to read.
Where Lucas absorbs pain, Teo converts patterns into navigation. Their friendship works because each corrects the other's blind spot.

meaning.realization: Reading people becomes most powerful where the system is built from relationships.

entities.name: The Cessation
entities.subtitle: The day engineered electrical civilization stopped.
entities.summary: A celestial disturbance disrupts engineered electrical conduction globally while biological electrochemistry continues. Dark Beings amplify the collapse.
body: The Cessation is not a clean apocalypse. It is a systems failure whose first consequences are ordinary: water pumps, hospitals, food, transport, communication and trust.
At the same time, protections around hidden places weaken. The visible world becomes less certain precisely when people have the least capacity to interpret what they are seeing.

timeline.title: Engineered conduction fails
timeline.summary: Grids, electronics, batteries and communication stop functioning.

timeline.title: Fear compounds failure
timeline.summary: Dark Beings amplify already unstable emotional fields.

timeline.title: Local worlds replace distant systems
timeline.summary: Water, food, practical knowledge and trust become immediate infrastructure.

meaning.realization: When scaffolding disappears, character and local capability become visible.

entities.name: The Luminaries
entities.subtitle: A hidden tradition concerned with balance rather than rule.
entities.summary: An ancient lineage that treats power as disciplined relation between consciousness, emotion, environment and matter.
body: Luminaries do not define themselves through spectacle. Their central discipline is restraint: observe first, understand the field, and intervene only when the action preserves agency rather than replacing it.
Their hidden settlements, outposts and practices exist to sustain knowledge that becomes dangerous when separated from responsibility.

meaning.realization: Greater capability increases responsibility rather than entitlement.

entities.name: The Silent Proving
entities.subtitle: Worthiness observed in an ordinary life.
entities.summary: A Luminary child grows up without knowledge of their lineage. Character is observed through genuine choices, not manufactured tests.
body: The Proving is deliberately invisible to the child. School, friendships, mistakes and difficulty must remain real because a staged trial would only measure performance.
Only after readiness is established does the hidden lineage become known.

process.title: Birth
process.summary: A child is born into a Luminary family, but inheritance grants no right to knowledge.

process.title: Ordinary life
process.summary: The family lives among ordinary humans. The child's choices remain genuinely their own.

process.title: Silent observation
process.summary: Character is read through natural responses to love, difficulty and responsibility.

process.title: Return — or not
process.summary: The lineage is revealed only when the person is genuinely ready.

meaning.realization: Being born near power does not make someone worthy of it.

entities.name: The Obscured Canvas
entities.subtitle: The dots are real. They are not the whole paper.
entities.summary: Reality is imagined as a white canvas beneath the accumulated dots of science, religion, culture, philosophy and personal experience.
body: Every system maps something real. The mistake begins when the visible marks are mistaken for the whole surface.
Luminaries are not omniscient. Their difference is that they remain aware of the white space between what has already been named.

meaning.realization: What has been documented is real without being the boundary of reality.

entities.name: Dark Beings
entities.subtitle: Corruption as unresolved intent rather than a separate species.
entities.summary: Humans transformed by accumulated grief, rage, obsession or despair; they grow through negative feedback loops and cannot be resolved by destruction alone.
body: A Dark Being amplifies what is already present in people and places. Fear becomes easier to sustain, despair becomes environmental, and conflict feeds the next conflict.
The Luminary answer is restoration where possible: weaken the feeding loop, bind safely, and attempt to recover the human underneath.

meaning.realization: Destroying a carrier does not necessarily resolve the cause.
